This small plot of 0.20 hectares is rented, so I must be careful not to spend too much money on it since the land is not mine. I grow yam and cassava here in the South South — the soil is still fair, and with the rains we get, I don't need to irrigate. I will buy a small bag of NPK to help the tubers, and add some goat manure I collect at home. I plant the cassava stems and yam setts I saved from last season, as the improved ones are costly and not always easy to find in my village. My children and I will do most of the work, but for making the yam heaps and harvesting I will hire a few young men to help.
